title: [Master] Purchase Return Order Posting Fails for Manually Reserved Lot-Tracked Items with Exact Cost Reversing Mandatory Enabled: "Applies-to Entry must not be filled out when reservations exist in Item Ledger Entry Entry No.='XXX'"
summary: Purchase return order posting now correctly handles manually reserved lot-tracked items when exact cost reversing is mandatory by automatically deriving the applies-to entry from the existing reservation during posting.
key_points: Fixes posting failure for lot-tracked purchase returns with manual reservations when exact cost reversing mandatory is enabled
Automatically restores the exact-cost reversing link from the reserved item ledger entry when applies-to entry is blank
Eliminates the need for manual intervention to fill the applies-to entry when a return line is fully reserved
Preserves reservation integrity throughout the posting process
Added test coverage for this specific scenario
